page.overview:
Who is Arkane?

Arkane was one of the four Bison Troopers to be experimented and turned into cyborgs. He has undergone rigorous physical training. Their mission is to eliminate Guile and his forces.

Arkane is equipped with an ultrasonic vibration device that allows him to teleport and generate electricity for use in his attacks. Being a cyborg, he's also able to stretch his arms and legs.

Arkane's moves in Street Fighter: The Movie (arcade version)
